item.title: Divvy adding 200 stations in 2026, holding new member price at $99
item.description: <p>The price of an annual Divvy bike-share membership for new or returning riders will remain $99, the city announced Monday.</p><p>The discount, a break from the normal price of $143 for current members, comes as the city plans to expand the number of Divvy stations by 200 in 2026.</p><p>Divvy, Chicago’s bike and scooter share system operated by Lyft, saw its highest annual ridership in 2025 with 6.8 million trips, according to an announcement from the city. item.title: Bulls continue hinting they are invested in keeping guard Jaden Ivey
item.description: <p>Coach <b>Billy Donovan’s</b> comments Monday about guard <b>Jaden Ivey</b> didn’t sound like due diligence with free agency just a few months away — they sounded like confirmation the Bulls want to invest in his future.</p><p>Earlier in the day, the Bulls said Ivey was progressing in his program to strengthen his sore left knee, which has kept him out since mid-February, and that he’d be reevaluated again in a week in hopes of getting him back to action before the end of the regular season.</

item.title: After fires, officials prepare to remove another homeless encampment on Chicago’s Northwest Side
item.description: <p>Snow and ice covered Carmen Laude’s wheelchair. A mattress, turned upright, served as the front door of her tent in Legion Park, which straddles a mile of the Chicago River on the Northwest Side.</p><p>Inside the tent, Laude, 72, cooked soup over a propane-powered stove.
